verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform with reporting components, so in-product AI-generated insights from payment and merchant data is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents AI-driven insights or suggestions. The revenue calculator and real-time underwriting verifications are rule- or questionnaire-based features, not AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
